## Shared scenes

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals his identity to Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), explaining that they are now his prisoners on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Despite their lack of freedom, he offers them a tour of the vessel and shares a meal consisting entirely of marine-sourced food. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) expresses his deep disdain for terrestrial society and his profound love for the independence found beneath the sea.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) gives Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) a detailed tour of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), explaining how electricity derived from sea water powers the vessel's systems, navigation, and machinery. They inspect the ship's layout, including the small boat, kitchen, and engine room, before [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to the saloon to discuss the mechanics of depth control.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) takes the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to the surface to fix their position before setting a course through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). Later, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) shows [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) the wonders of the sea through the saloon's viewing panels, where they observe various marine life. The chapter concludes with [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) reflecting on the mysterious life of the Captain while the vessel continues its journey.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER

> After several days of isolation, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) to a hunting expedition at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). Before departing, the Captain explains the advanced technology they will use, including [Rouquayrol](../codex/tech.md#rouquayrol) diving apparatus and electric air-guns, to survive and hunt in the submarine environment. The group then prepares to don their specialized gear for the excursion.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on an underwater excursion, equipping them with specialized diving gear and air-powered guns. After exiting the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a water-tight chamber, the group walks across the sea floor, observing the vibrant marine life and vegetation. The excursion concludes as they reach the forest of the Island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) observes the daily routines and scientific observations conducted by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and his crew aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) as they traverse the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). During their journey, they pass landmarks like Hawaii and the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas), collecting specimens and studying the ocean's depths. The chapter concludes with a somber discovery when the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) encounters the wreckage of a sunken ship, the Florida, containing the preserved bodies of its crew.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), eventually arriving at [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), the site of the [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) shipwreck. The narrator recounts the history of the search for the lost vessels, after which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals he has discovered the final resting place of the survivors' makeshift boat and possesses the original naval instructions from the expedition.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO

> After the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) runs aground on a reef near the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains calm and expresses confidence that the upcoming full moon's tide will refloat the vessel. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) receive permission from the Captain to go ashore to hunt for fresh game. The trio successfully reaches the island, with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) eager to find land-based food.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

> After being chased back to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) by hostile [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans), Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and his companions wait for the ship to refloat. Despite the surrounding natives, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains unconcerned and eventually prepares the vessel to depart the coral reef, inviting [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to witness how he will handle the boarders.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) prepares to depart the coral reef, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals that the ship's exterior railings are electrified to repel the surrounding [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans). [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) accidentally experiences the shock himself, and the vessel successfully breaks free from the reef to sail away, leaving the terrified attackers behind.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean) while Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) conducts deep-sea temperature experiments and the passengers observe a phosphorescent sea. Tensions rise when Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) spots something on the horizon, leading him to abruptly confine [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) to their cabin. The three men are then drugged via their breakfast, causing them to fall into a deep, forced sleep as the submarine changes its behavior.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA”

> After waking up to find his companions and himself back in their rooms, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) is summoned by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) to treat a mortally wounded crewman. Following the man's death, the Captain leads [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a submarine excursion to a coral forest, where they hold a solemn funeral service to bury the deceased crew member in an underwater cemetery.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM

> The narrator reflects on the mysterious nature of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) while the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean). During the journey, the crew observes various marine life, including shoals of argonauts and sharks, and witnesses the natural phenomenon of a 'milk sea' caused by bioluminescent organisms.
>
> — v2 · PART TWO

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and his companions to visit the pearl fisheries of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon), mentioning the potential danger of sharks. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), feeling uneasy about the prospect of encountering sharks underwater, later explains the nature of pearl fishing to [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md). Despite the risks, the group prepares for the upcoming excursion.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a submarine excursion to the pearl banks of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon). While observing a native diver, the group witnesses a shark attack; Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) engages the shark in a life-or-death struggle, and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) ultimately kills the beast with his harpoon. The group rescues the Indian diver and returns him to his boat before attempting to revive him.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) engages in a life-or-death struggle with a shark to save an Indian diver, but is nearly killed until [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) intervenes and kills the beast. After reviving the diver and gifting him a bag of pearls, the group returns to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). The event leaves Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) reflecting on Captain Nemo's hidden capacity for compassion toward the oppressed.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels from the Laccadive Archipelago through the Sea of [Oman](../codex/places.md#oman) and into the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea). During the journey, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discuss their uncertain destination, while [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) later engages Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) in a detailed conversation about the history of the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and the [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) Canal. The chapter concludes with Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) revealing that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) will reach the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) by traveling through a natural subterranean passage beneath the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) hunt a giant dugong near the Arabian coast, eventually killing it after it attacks their boat. Later, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) navigates the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a secret tunnel beneath the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez), successfully transitioning the vessel from the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) into the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL

> After entering the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discusses escape plans with Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), though the professor remains hesitant. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) later uses a diver to transport a chest of gold to an unknown destination and subsequently guides the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a dangerous submarine volcanic eruption near [Santorin](../codex/places.md#santorin). The vessel eventually departs the area, leaving the professor to reflect on the perils of attempting an escape in such volatile waters.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels at high speed through the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean), preventing [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) from attempting an escape. During the journey, the narrator discusses geological history and the future of the earth with [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) while the vessel navigates past submarine barriers. [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) eventually exits the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) through the Straits of [Gibraltar](../codex/places.md#gibraltar) and enters the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) plans an escape attempt for that night, leaving Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) in a state of anxious indecision. However, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) stops in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay), where Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) interrupts [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to recount the history of the sunken Spanish galleons. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) then reveals that he has been harvesting the immense treasure from these wrecks to fund his operations.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY

> After failing to escape the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) confirm their location in the middle of the ocean. Later, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) on a deep-sea excursion, where they walk along the ocean floor to discover the ruins of the lost continent of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis) illuminated by an underwater volcano.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) enters an underwater cavern inside an extinct volcano, which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses as a secret base to mine coal and replenish his sodium reserves. Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) explore the interior of the volcanic crater, where they gather honey and hunt game. After the crew completes their work, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) departs the refuge to continue its voyage through the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Sargasso Sea](../codex/places.md#sargasso-sea) and across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), during which the narrator reflects on their captivity and Captain Nemo's mysterious nature. Later, the submarine performs a deep-sea sounding operation, reaching extreme depths where Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses photography to capture the underwater landscape before rapidly ascending to the surface.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss the crew size of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) with Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), reflecting Ned's growing restlessness. Later, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) encounters a pod of whales and a group of attacking cachalots; Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses the vessel to slaughter the cachalots to protect the whales. The chapter concludes with the crew harvesting milk from a dead whale, while [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) notes Ned's intensifying resentment toward the Captain.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) becomes trapped in an impassable field of ice while navigating the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic). Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals his audacious plan to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) by traveling beneath the icebergs, and after preparing the vessel, he successfully maneuvers the submarine into the depths to continue their journey.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) travel to a peak in the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) to observe the sun at the equinox. Using a chronometer and instruments, they confirm their arrival at the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) at noon. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) then plants a black flag to claim the territory in his own name.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is struck by an iceberg and becomes trapped in an icy tunnel. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) works to maneuver the vessel, but after several shocks and failed attempts to navigate the passage, he informs the narrator that all exits are blocked, leaving them trapped.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT?

> Trapped under an iceberg, the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) faces the dual threats of suffocation and being crushed by freezing water. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads a grueling effort to dig a trench through the ice while using the ship's machinery to pump boiling water to prevent further solidification. Ultimately, the crew uses the weight of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to break through the final layer of ice, successfully freeing the vessel.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR

> The narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) recover their strength on the platform of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) while discussing their desire to escape. As the submarine travels north along the coast of South [America](../codex/places.md#united-states), the narrator observes various marine life and geological features, while Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains unseen. The journey continues past the [Amazon](../codex/places.md#amazon) and the equator, marked by scientific observations and a dangerous encounter between [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and an electric ray.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON

> While the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is stalled by giant cuttlefish entangled in its screw, the crew and passengers engage in a desperate hand-to-hand battle on the deck. During the violent struggle, one crew member is snatched away by a monster, and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) is nearly killed before being saved by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). The creatures are eventually driven off, leaving the crew exhausted and mourning their lost companion.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS

> Following the death of a crew member, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) becomes withdrawn while the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream). [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), desperate to escape as they near North [America](../codex/places.md#united-states), urges Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to confront the Captain about their captivity. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) refuses to grant them freedom, and the chapter concludes with the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) braving a violent hurricane off the coast of [Long Island](../codex/places.md#long-island).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), tracing the path of the transatlantic telegraph cable and eventually arriving near the coast of [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) guides the vessel to a specific location on the ocean floor to observe the wreckage of the French ship 'The Avenger'. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) recounts the ship's heroic final battle, revealing his somber connection to the site on the anniversary of its sinking.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is pursued by an unidentified warship that begins firing upon them. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), driven by a deep-seated hatred for the vessel's nation, refuses to let his companions signal for help and eventually rams and sinks the ship. After watching the vessel and its crew perish, [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) retreats to his quarters to mourn his own lost family.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB

> After weeks of isolation and growing horror toward Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), the narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) plan their escape from the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). As they attempt to detach their small boat, they discover the submarine has been caught in the Maelstrom off the coast of [Norway](../codex/places.md#norway). The boat is violently torn away from the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), leaving the narrator unconscious.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO

> The narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) find themselves safe in a fisherman's hut on the Loffoden Isles after escaping the maelstrom. The narrator reflects on their incredible journey and wonders about the fate of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), hoping that the captain has found peace.
>
